paper_source.title: First-Person Indexed Subjectivity: Self-Binding, Ownership, Continuity, Irreducibility, and Cross-Substrate Consequence in a Causally Rigid Framework

limitations: SRT-2 perspective is a minimal internal comparison between an indexed factorization and a neutral baseline.
It depends on SelfIndex, OwnershipField, and ContinuityField already being minimally supported.
This artifact does not establish strong phenomenal first-person perspective.
interpretation_boundary: Framework-internal only; pre-comparator perspective diagnostic, not externally validated, not sufficient for subjectivity claim, not equivalent to strong phenomenal perspective, not human perspective equivalence.
